attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.5% tax rate with Taxpayer Tax Credit per Utah tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Utah Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_description: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate UT tax for single filer
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.ut_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /ut_agi xdef
ut_agi result.standard_deduction sub 0 max
result.ut_tax_rate mul
dup /ut_base_tax ldef
result.standard_deduction result.ut_personal_exemption result.num_dependents mul add result.ut_taxpayer_credit_rate mul
result.agi result.ut_credit_phaseout_single gt result.agi result.ut_credit_phaseout_single sub result.ut_credit_phaseout_rate mul 0 max sub 0 max if
ut_base_tax swap sub 0 max
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Utah tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah military retirement exclusion calculation. UT allows up to $10,000 exemption on military retirement pay with income caps: Single $50k, Joint $65k AGI. Must choose between military retirement or Social Security exemption. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize UT military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "UT Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status get "Single" eq result.agi get result.ut_military_exemption_agi_cap_single get le and
result.filing_status get "MFJ" eq result.agi get result.ut_military_exemption_agi_cap_joint get le and

action_details.action_comment: Apply UT $10,000 military retirement exemption (within AGI cap)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.ut_military_retirement_exemption get min /ut_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get ut_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"UT military retirement exemption applied: $" ut_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ut_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay get /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"UT military retirement exemption not applicable - AGI exceeds cap: $" result.agi get cvs strconcat " (Fully taxable: $" strconcat result.ut_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exemption
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ut_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No UT military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
